_meta.project: Field Shift — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
_meta.selection_method: Selected 3 official ITGC (Institut Technique des Grandes Cultures) rainfed cereal-legume-oilseed benchmark zones forming an east-west & aridity gradient across Algeria's High Plateaux. Mitidja was replaced by Constantine/El Khroub because Mitidja (600-800+ mm) is dominated by irrigated horticulture and citrus orchards rather than extensive dryland cereal-legume rotations.
sources: ITGC Algeria (itgc.dz) — experimental stations at Setif, El Khroub (Constantine), Tiaret
ICARDA WANA Mediterranean cereal-legume rotation trials
FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper No. 56 & FAOSTAT

regionA.name: Sétif High Plateaux
regionA.dominant_system: Durum wheat / barley historically rotated with fallow; shifting to Barley/Wheat + Lentil/Chickpea + Forage Oats & direct seeding.
key_hazards: Terminal heat >35 C at grain filling

regionB.name: Constantine / El Khroub High Plains
regionB.zone: Sub-Humid to Semi-Arid Eastern Cereal-Pulse Hub
regionB.dominant_system: High-potential Durum Wheat + Faba Bean / Lentil + Rapeseed (Canola) under direct seeding (semis direct).
key_hazards: Ascochyta blight & Fusarium rust in wet springs
Orobanche (broomrape) on faba bean if repeated

regionC.name: Tiaret Western High Plateaux
regionC.zone: Semi-Arid to Sub-Humid Transition Cereal Belt
regionC.dominant_system: Large-scale mechanized Durum/Bread Wheat & Barley transitioning via CCLS to Chickpea/Field Pea/Forage + emerging Canola trials.
key_hazards: Wild oat grass-weed infestation in continuous cereals
